p.src: Who are the most important people in my life?

u.src: Who are the most important people in my life?
en: Who are the most important people in my life?

p.src: Who else is important enough to deserve serious time and energy?

u.src: Who else is important enough to deserve serious time and energy?
en: Who else is important enough to deserve serious time and energy?

p.src: In what way can we grow together?

u.src: In what way can we grow together?
en: In what way can we grow together?

p.src: What growth opportunity can I create for them?

u.src: What growth opportunity can I create for them?
en: What growth opportunity can I create for them?

p.src: If someone refuses all shared growth, what boundary or adjustment is necessary?

u.src: If someone refuses all shared growth, what boundary or adjustment is necessary?
en: If someone refuses all shared growth, what boundary or adjustment is necessary?

p.src: These questions reveal the real structure of one’s life. Many people say family is important, but spend no deliberate growth time with family. Many say friends are important, but share only entertainment and complaint. Many say employees are important, but provide only tasks and pressure. Many say they want freedom, but spend their best attention with people who resist growth.

p.src: The road to wealth freedom is not walked by an isolated calculator. It is built through attention, work, capital, judgment, and relationships. The people around us either raise the standard of our time or lower it.

p.src: To trade time like a sane person, begin with your own.

u.src: To trade time like a sane person, begin with your own.

p.src: Do not merely sell it. Use it to grow.

u.src: Do not merely sell it. Use it to grow.

p.src: Do not merely raise its price. Raise its value.

u.src: Do not merely raise its price. Raise its value.
en: Do not merely raise its price. Raise its value.

p.src: Do not merely buy other people’s time. Become qualified to make that time more valuable.

u.src: Do not merely buy other people’s time. Become qualified to make that time more valuable.
en: Do not merely buy other people’s time. Become qualified to make that time more valuable.

p.src: And with the people who matter most, do not merely pass time together. Grow together.
